description: Chains only: link this location to its brand's shared site (linked=true) so it shows the brand template's pages and theme, or unlink it (linked=false) to use its own site again. Hours, address, menus and ordering always stay this location's own. The brand template is set with publish_brand_template.

linked.description: true = show the brand's shared site here; false = this location's own site
